description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.


About the Role

Owns datacenter design and technical standards for Lambda’s AI infrastructure. Sets the basis of design, builds a repeatable and scalable set of reference designs, and leads the design team that delivers efficient, reliable, buildable facilities for current and next-generation GPU platforms.


What You’ll Do

Basis of design and standards

  • Own Lambda’s datacenter basis of design: electrical topology, mechanical and cooling options, and building architecture.

  • Maintain standard building modules and reference designs that scale across site sizes and capacities using a common equipment set.

  • Run design change control and manage approved deviations so designs stay consistent across regions.

AI infrastructure readiness

  • Ensure designs support current and upcoming GPU cabinet power and cooling densities, including liquid cooling and high-density row distribution.

  • Coordinate regularly with GPU, server, and networking partners so facility designs stay flexible across platform generations.

  • Drive efficiency (PUE), reliability, constructability, and cost in every design decision.

Site master planning and design delivery

  • Lead site master planning for candidate and new sites, working with Power and Site Development on power and land constraints.

  • Direct third-party architecture and engineering firms through concept, schematic, and construction documents against schedule and budget.

  • Drive prefabrication and modular delivery with Construction and the supply chain.

Equipment specification

  • Own owner-furnished equipment specifications and required equipment lists; review and approve vendor proposals and submittals.

  • Support long-lead equipment forecasting with Construction and procurement.

Team and quality

  • Lead the Mechanical Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Architect, and TPM; set design review and quality processes and hire as the portfolio grows.

  • Ensure code compliance and professional engineering oversight of design deliverables.

You

  • 15+ years designing critical facilities or datacenters, including 5+ years leading design teams.

  • Hands-on depth in mechanical (chilled water, heat rejection, liquid cooling) and electrical design for large-scale datacenters.

  • Experience developing design standards and reference designs for multi-site programs.

  • Experience managing third-party architecture and engineering firms and design budgets.

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, or architecture; licensed Professional Engineer strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with 100 MW+ campuses and AI/GPU density, including liquid-cooled IT.

  • Site masterplanning and power acquisition experience, including on-site generation options.

  • Experience harmonizing design standards across regions.

  • LEED accreditation or similar sustainability credential.

Key Interfaces

DC MEP Operations · Construction · Power and Site Development · Systems/SCADA/Metrics · EHS, Community & Sustainability · GPU, server, and equipment vendors · A/E firms

First-Year Success Measures

  • Basis of design and reference designs published, with a documented change-control process.

  • Owner-furnished equipment specifications and approved vendor list in place for active projects.

  • Design team roles filled and design review cadence running across all active sites.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer
